title: Cost ledger data models and pure functions — CostEvent, CostReport, record/rollup/trend
acceptance_criteria: CostEvent dataclass: decision_id, event_type (agent_time|rework|api_call), amount, currency, timestamp, metadata
CostReport dataclass: total_cost, cost_per_decision list, rework_costs, roi_scores, trend_data
record_cost_event(events, event) -> list[CostEvent] pure function, appends and returns new list
rollup_costs(events) -> dict[str, float] pure function, sums cost by decision_id
compute_roi(decisions, cost_map, confidence_scores) -> dict[str, float] pure function
compute_trend(events, bucket='month') -> list[dict] pure function, groups events by time bucket
All functions <50 lines, no side effects
